svg.text: Fig 2 · Reff across the (ρ, τ) plane. Blue = damped (self-healing); red = turbulent (self-destabilizing).
Correlated detection (1−γρτ): because γρτ grows with both controls at once, high
ρ and high τ together cross into the damped regime where either alone stays
